channel.title: Burkina Faso - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Burkina Faso, every source cited.

item.title: Burkina Faso citizens rally for President Traoré
item.description: Hundreds gathered in Bobo-Dioulasso on October 31, 2026, to express support for the RPP and the president.

item.title: Burkina Faso army marks 66 years with 56 awards
item.description: The Minister of War praised soldiers fighting terrorism and honoured 56 individuals with distinctions.

item.title: Burkina Faso firms urged to secure digital identities
item.description: A digital lab in Ouagadougou highlighted risks to domain names and online branding for businesses.

item.title: Paul Daumont gains time in Tour du Faso
item.description: Burkinabè cyclist Paul Daumont is now 44 seconds behind the yellow jersey after the third stage.

item.title: Man gets life for acid attack on partner in Dori
item.description: A Dori court sentenced a man to life in prison for brutally attacking his pregnant partner after she refused an abortion.
